label: Pro 2.1.0
title: Ready-made recipes
lede: Pro 2.1.0 adds finished building blocks for the screens you build again and again: forms in a sheet, photo galleries and swipeable list rows. It also adds a spring editor to tune a spring by eye.

items.title: Form in a bottom sheet
items.text: formSheet wraps a form in a sheet that handles focus, the Tab trap, the on-screen keyboard, submit and error state, and a guard against losing unsaved changes.

items.title: Photo gallery that opens from its thumbnail
items.text: lightbox turns a grid of thumbnails into a viewer. The picture grows out of its thumbnail, you swipe between pictures and drag down to close, and the keyboard and focus behave as in a dialog.

items.title: List rows with swipe actions
items.text: swipeRows slides a row aside to show actions like delete or archive. A vertical drag still scrolls the page, and the actions work with the keyboard: Alt+ArrowLeft opens a row, Escape or Alt+ArrowRight closes it.

items.title: Spring editor
items.text: springEditor gives you sliders, a curve, a preview ball and copy-ready code to tune a spring. springCurve samples a spring. The editor is in beta: its markup and class names may still change.

items.title: Adapters for Vue and Svelte
items.text: The new recipes come with composables for Vue and actions for Svelte, next to the React hooks. All Pro packages share one version number.

note: Pro code is not shipped in a browser demo. The recipes are tested in jsdom and Chromium, not yet on a real mobile keyboard or in Safari and Firefox.
